field_principles.claim_boundary: Keep exact validity, not parseability, as the headline.
field_principles.duration_s: Retain monotonic task wall time in seconds.
field_principles.field_principles: State one-line purpose for every retained field.
field_principles.frozen_manifest: Freeze instances, orders, prompts, seeds, and budgets.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Expose every terminal gate and first failed observation.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Retain lease, offload, VRAM, and teardown evidence.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Give a terminal plain-language result with required prefix.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Name the required local CUDA GGUF runtime.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: Distinguish real first-token inference from preflight.
field_principles.model_specs: Retain exact IDs, paths, hashes, roles, tokenizers, and limits.
field_principles.models_used: List only models that actually emitted a first token.
field_principles.parseable_rate_by_arm: Report syntax success separately from exactness.
field_principles.proof_transport_ab_completed: Gate Exp6771 on rows, replay, and teardown.
field_principles.random_seed: Retain the frozen paired seed schedule root.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind manifest, code receipt, rows, and conclusions.
field_principles.reproducibility_receipt: Retain hashes that make the checksum attributable.
field_principles.row_consistency_errors: Expose pairing, budget, hash, and attribution drift.
field_principles.runtime_mask_invocations_by_arm: Count actual constrained runtime calls by arm.
field_principles.status: Expose complete, partial, or blocked execution state.
field_principles.title: Name the paired proof-transport comparison.
field_principles.token_cost_by_arm: Report generated-token cost under equal ceilings.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed experiment verdict vocabulary.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: State that the checker evaluates but is not an arm.
